about_the_game:
immersiX, blending art and science

ImmersiX is a multi-content app poised to revolutionize visual storytelling across any Open XR headset.

ImmersiX seamlessly blends the creative essence of immersion with the scientific power of six degrees of freedom (6DoF), bridging the worlds of art, science, and technology in ways never seen before.

This next-generation app not only showcases original movies from V-Nova Studios, but also opens the door for third-party creators to add their own immersive experiences, making ImmersiX a dynamic hub for world-class XR storytelling. Audiences are transported beyond imagination, exploring breathtaking worlds with complete freedom and presence.

Powered by the groundbreaking V-Nova PresenZ format, ImmersiX delivers hyper-realistic visuals, offering an unprecedented, authentic, sense of movement and detail that rivals reality itself. Coupled with spatial audio, the experience becomes truly lifelike, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in entertainment and technology.

ImmersiX is more than an experience — it is a new frontier in storytelling, where viewers don’t just watch— they feel, explore, and connect like never before.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Home or Pro) or newer
  • Processor: Intel 8-core, 2.9 GHz base clock
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080ti (only NVIDIA GPUs are supported)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • VR Support: Any Open XR headset
  • Additional Notes: Sata III SSD (minimum) or preferably NVME SSD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Home or Pro) or newer
  • Processor: Intel 8-core, 2.9 GHz base clock
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 Super, RTX 3060 Ti, or RTX 4060 (or newer; only NVIDIA GPUs are supported)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, 3, or 3S

short_description: Explore a new era of immersive experiences. Live within.
